text: Unless men are maddened in the battlefield, they "cannot stand it" to hear appeals for help, and not to respond to them. The hero goes; and what the hero does, all feel that they ought to have done as well. The sophisms of the brain cannot resist the mutual-aid feeling, because this feeling has been nurtured by thousands of years of human social life.
author: Peter Kropotkin
reference: Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution
locator: Chapter VIII, Mutual Aid Amongst Ourselves (continued)
